reviews.body:
Thank you. This is correct and small:

- It retries only when the refusal names `root`, and only once. A second refusal is reported as before.
- The regex is case-insensitive, so it also matches the daemon's own spelling (`Unknown parameters for …`).
- Your second test pins that any other refusal is not retried.

Naming both versions and `reticle update` can be a follow-up. Do not add it here. The branch merges cleanly onto main, so I am merging it.

comments.body: Thanks for your first pull request to Reticle! A maintainer aims to review within two days. Before then, `pnpm verify` locally catches most of what CI will, and [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/reticlehq/reticle/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) explains the rest. If CI does not start, a maintainer needs to approve it for first-time contributors; that is normal.
